scope: Existing QuorumRestartTest#testRollingRestart under IOException/FileNotFoundException I/O injection; this does not rule out other test selectors or fault models.
source_findings: QuorumRestartTest.java:62-74 restarts each of three peers sequentially and waits for quorum reconnection; it has no application client write or deliberate acceptedEpoch increase.

Follower.java:90-104 connects to the leader, calls registerWithLeader, then immediately checks whether the proposed epoch is below self.getAcceptedEpoch. An IOException from the packet read/write path aborts this follower attempt before the selected guard.

QuorumPeer.java:1180-1191 catches FileNotFoundException while reading acceptedEpoch and substitutes epochOfZxid. For a persisted acceptedEpoch later than the last transaction epoch, this fallback lowers rather than raises the operand needed for the selected newEpoch < acceptedEpoch throw.

QuorumPeer.java:2184-2195 readLongFromFile can throw IOException, but other read failures from startup propagate through loadDataBase at lines 1199-1201 as RuntimeException before QuorumPeer's client/quorum startup.

The previous frozen healthy trace had a valid named, observed packet path; the six exact-injection pilot had no same-occurrence postfault target and no time-respecting observed fault-to-target path under the strict actor audit. Repeating those packet faults cannot be treated as a new exploration result.
followup: Require a different existing cluster test and a source-relevant fault that can raise the follower acceptedEpoch or lower the proposed epoch while the same follower reaches the exact guard.
